```{python}
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '..')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown
from flagweather.config import EXCLUDE_GAUGES, SNOTEL
from flagweather.figures.events import gauge_map
from flagweather.sources import gauges, snotel

net = gauges.network()
sno = snotel.stations(list(SNOTEL))
asof = pd.Timestamp(net.latest.max()).tz_convert('America/Phoenix')
Markdown(f'Rolling totals as of {asof:%b %d, %Y %H:%M} MST.')
```

## Rain gauges

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "City of Flagstaff and Coconino County ALERT rain gauges (circle area proportional to 30-day total, labels in inches), SNOTEL sites (triangles) and the Flagstaff airport (square)."
gauge_map(net, net.last_P30D, '30-day rain total (in)', sno)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
t = net[['site', 'owner', 'lat', 'lon', 'last_P1D', 'last_P7D', 'last_P30D']].sort_values('site')
t.columns = ['Site', 'Owner', 'Lat', 'Lon', '1-day (in)', '7-day (in)', '30-day (in)']
Markdown(t.round({'Lat': 3, 'Lon': 3, '1-day (in)': 2, '7-day (in)': 2, '30-day (in)': 2}).to_markdown(index=False))
```

```{python}
Markdown(f'The gauges are 1-mm tipping buckets operated for flood warning by the City of Flagstaff and Coconino County. '
         f'Totals are provisional and not quality controlled. Gauges near Williams '
         f'({", ".join(EXCLUDE_GAUGES.values())}) are excluded.')
```

## SNOTEL sites

```{python}
s = sno.reset_index()[['name', 'triplet', 'lat', 'lon', 'elev_ft', 'begin']]
s.columns = ['Site', 'Station', 'Lat', 'Lon', 'Elevation (ft)', 'Record begins']
Markdown(s.to_markdown(index=False))
```

## Flagstaff airport

NWS Flagstaff Pulliam Airport (35.144°N, 111.666°W), threaded record from RCC-ACIS, used for daily and monthly temperature, precipitation and snowfall.
